title: Coral and the Protocol
author: D. M. Ravensworth
blurb: Ada Iversen, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
